key_facts: France has a dynamic and robust AI ecosystem, with over 1,000 AI-focused startups as of 2024.
In 2024, French AI startups raised €1.9 billion, with 30% of national venture capital investments dedicated to AI, leading ahead of the United States.
SoftBank plans to expand in France, working with Schneider Electric and EDF for data centers and AI hardware supply chains.
Mistral AI, a French AI company, has raised significant funding, with a valuation reaching €11.7 billion after a €1.7 billion round in September 2025.
Other notable French AI companies include Poolside, H, Photoroom, Aqemia, Bioptimus, Flex.AI, and DUST.
Artefact is a French AI company specializing in Data Marketing and AI, advising large companies on Data Driven strategies and developing AI solutions.
France has ambitious public policies and a dynamic entrepreneurial fabric supporting its AI sector, with programs like French Tech 2030 and Bpifrance.
Some French funds are opening offices in San Francisco, indicating a connection between the French and US tech ecosystems.
Expats can invest in French startups and innovative businesses, but should consult tax professionals and conduct comprehensive risk assessments.
statistics: Since 2021, the number of AI-focused startups in France has doubled, now exceeding 1,000 companies.
In 2024, French AI startups raised €1.9 billion.
30% of national venture capital investments in France are dedicated to AI.

Mistral AI raised €105 million in June 2023 and €385 million in December 2023.
ASML invested €1.3 billion in Mistral AI, acquiring 11% of its capital.
